finding_admission.note: No newly discovered compiler finding is admitted in v1. Historical studies remain explicitly labelled adapters, not corpus discoveries.

metamorphic_properties.title: Elementwise addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: x + y and y + x produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Double transpose is identity
metamorphic_properties.description: Transposing a rank-two tensor twice restores the original tensor.

metamorphic_properties.title: Reshape round trip is identity
metamorphic_properties.description: Flattening and restoring a rank-two tensor preserves every element.

metamorphic_properties.title: Matrix product transpose rule
metamorphic_properties.description: (x @ y).T and y.T @ x.T produce equivalent outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Double negation is identity
metamorphic_properties.description: Negating a tensor twice preserves values and signed zero.

metamorphic_properties.title: Subtraction is addition of negation
metamorphic_properties.description: x - y and x + (-y) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute value is idempotent
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(x) and abs(abs(x)) produce equivalent outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Integer elementwise addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: int32 x + y and y + x produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Float64 elementwise addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: float64 x + y and y + x produce equivalent outputs in an explicit JAX x64 process.

metamorphic_properties.title: Mixed int32/float32 addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: int32 x + float32 y and float32 y + int32 x use same-operation promotion semantics consistently.

metamorphic_properties.title: Double negation preserves signed zero
metamorphic_properties.description: Negating signed-zero inputs twice preserves both values and zero signs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute value is idempotent for non-finite inputs
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(x) and abs(abs(x)) agree for NaN, infinities, and signed zero under the explicit policy.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute value is idempotent for finite extremes
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(x) and abs(abs(x)) agree for finite values spanning normal and subnormal boundaries.

metamorphic_properties.title: Elementwise maximum commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: maximum(x, y) and maximum(y, x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Elementwise minimum commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: minimum(x, y) and minimum(y, x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Square is self-multiplication
metamorphic_properties.description: square(x) and mul(x, x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Square of negation is identity with square
metamorphic_properties.description: square(x) and square(-x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Min-max global reduction duality
metamorphic_properties.description: min(x) and -max(-x) produce equivalent reduction outputs.
